official.deadline_note: Online pre-registration window: 8:00 a.m. on 5 August 2026 to 5:00 p.m. on 20 October 2026; the II-2026 call is published as 'EXTENDIDA HASTA EL 20 DE OCTUBRE'. The previous I-2026 call ran 15 January to 20 March. Results for II-2026 will be communicated to non-winners in January-February 2027.
official.status_note: The II-2026 call is open on the Foundation's application-instructions page ('Convocatoria II-2026 abierta'); the pre-registration form is available until 5:00 p.m. on 20 October 2026 per the official Bases.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Bases state that in no case may grant resources be used as a salary or to pay university tuition ('En ningún caso los recursos podrán utilizarse como salario, ni para cubrir costos de matrículas universitarias'); the FAQ confirms the Fund does not support undergraduate or master's tuition.
benefits: Economic support of up to COP $3,500,000 per grant, disbursed only to the beneficiary student, never to the thesis director or third parties
Grant resources may cover all expenses associated with developing the degree thesis: equipment and materials, laboratory inputs, travel costs, field upkeep, among others
Equipment purchased with the grant belongs to the grantee

One II-2026 grantee working on and in the Colombian Orinoquía gains access to the AKAE Conservación Reserve and its facilities for field research; AKAE covers transfer to the reserve by land and sea, plus lodging and food inside the reserve
Grant duration: one year for undergraduate and two years for master's students from award
eligibility: Ser estudiante de nacionalidad colombiana inscrito en uno o más programas de pregrado o maestría (Colombian nationality; enrolled in one or more undergraduate or master's programmes)
Colombian universities must be approved by ICFES; foreign universities must be formally recognised
Degree thesis on knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity, from any area of knowledge
Proposals must not exceed 50% of the execution schedule at the closing of the call
Applicants who participated in a previous call of the Fund cannot enrol again in the same category (only previous undergraduate applicants may now apply at master's level)
Multi-student applications must be collective, with all members from the same programme and a designated coordinator/representative
requirements: The proposal must be a research proposal; only research proposals qualify and non-thesis projects cannot participate

Research proposal of no more than five (5) letter-size pages in Times New Roman 12 pt with 1.5 cm margins, containing title, introduction (maximum four paragraphs including relevance), general and specific objectives, relevance of the study, methodological approach, expected results and correctly cited bibliography

Detailed and justified budget marking which lines would be covered by the grant and which by other funding sources; the amount requested from the Fund may not exceed $3'500.000, though the total project budget may exceed that value
Activity timetable including start and end months of the year and the current state of progress of the proposal

Declare in the methodology any use of Artificial Intelligence tools, at what moment of the research process they were or will be used, and for what; mention the framework collection permit covering sampling of wild species (if applicable)
Authorise the Foundation to process personal data under its data-treatment policy
documents: Research proposal of no more than five (5) pages (letter size, Times New Roman 12 pt, 1.5 cm margins)
Letter from the thesis director addressed to the Fondo de Becas Colombia Biodiversa certifying the proposal is approved for the degree work
Letter from the faculty on letterhead addressed to the Fondo de Becas Colombia Biodiversa certifying the proposal is approved for the degree work
Official enrolment certificate issued by the university
Recommendation letter issued by a faculty professor other than the thesis director
Student identity document (for collective proposals all documents must be uploaded unified in a single file)
selection_criteria: The Foundation appoints a jury of persons of the highest academic and human qualities

Proposals are evaluated against criteria previously defined by the Foundation, plus new criteria the jury incorporates unanimously, always aligned with the Fund's axes: knowledge, conservation and sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity from all areas of knowledge
The jury's ruling is recorded in an Acta, reviewed, approved and signed by all members, identifying the winners with a brief description of their work and the reasons they were chosen
Results are announced privately to winners by phone or video call by the Foundation's direction, followed by an official letter to start the disbursement process
coverage: All expenses associated with developing the degree thesis: equipment and materials, laboratory inputs, travel costs, field upkeep, among others
Equipment purchased with the grant becomes the property of the grantee
Never usable as a salary or to cover university tuition costs
AKAE Conservación agreement for one II-2026 grantee on Orinoquía field work: transfer costs to the reserve by land and sea, lodging and food within the reserve
application_method: Complete the online pre-registration form in three stages: (1) type of proposal (individual or collective), personal, work, publications and recommendations data; (2) category (undergraduate or master's), abstract, motivation and funding sources; (3) file uploads and a short survey
Upload to the system all requested documents listed in the Bases

The registration itself is performed by the Fundación Alejandro Ángel Escobar once it has verified the form was completed correctly and all documents were properly uploaded; the student then receives the definitive registration number by email
official.application_route: Online pre-registration form on the FAAE Colombia Biodiversa application-instructions page; FAAE verifies the form and uploads and emails the definitive registration number.
official.citizenship_residency: Open only to Colombian students (the call is open only for Colombian students); Colombian students at formally recognised foreign universities may participate provided the project relates directly to Colombian biodiversity
official.international_eligibility: No: foreign students cannot participate; the call is open only to Colombian students
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Students from all areas of knowledge may participate provided the degree project turns on the knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity; the proposal must be a research thesis, not a non-thesis project
official.research_requirement: An approved degree-thesis research proposal on knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity, not exceeding 50% of its execution schedule at the closing of the call
official.duration: Contract runs one year for undergraduate and two years for master's students counted from the award
official.description: The Fundación Alejandro Ángel Escobar's Fondo de Becas Colombia Biodiversa grants economic support to Colombian undergraduate and master's students to finance, partially or totally, the development of degree theses on the knowledge, conservation and sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity from all areas of knowledge.
official.program_type: Foundation thesis-research scholarship (beca de tesis de grado)

not_confirmed: English language requirement (not published by the awarding body)
Number of grants to be awarded in Convocatoria II-2026 (not published)
Detailed jury scoring criteria (sections say criteria are defined by the Foundation but do not publish them)
Study mode (full-time or part-time, not published)
verification.notes: Amount (maximum COP $3'500.000 per grant), II-2026 window (5 August to 5:00 p.m. 20 October 2026, extended), coverage wording, eligibility, documents, evaluation and grantee commitments confirmed on FAAE's own Bases PDF and application-instructions page.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a thesis-research grant, not a study scholarship: the Fundación Alejandro Ángel Escobar pays up to COP 3.5 million once, directly to a Colombian undergraduate or master's student whose faculty-approved thesis on Colombian biodiversity is just starting. The money is for the research itself - equipment, lab inputs, travel, field upkeep - and explicitly never for tuition or as a salary, so living costs remain your own responsibility. The II-2026 pre-registration window was extended to 5:00 p.m. on 20 October 2026, so the remaining runway is days, not months.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Colombian pregrado or maestría students at the very start of an approved biodiversity thesis, especially field or lab work needing equipment and travel money.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure the thesis director's letter and the faculty approval letter before starting the form - both must be addressed to the Fondo de Becas Colombia Biodiversa and the faculty letter must be on letterhead

Draft the proposal to spec (max five letter-size pages, Times New Roman 12, 1.5 cm margins, introduction of at most four paragraphs) and a line-by-line budget marking exactly which items the grant will cover, with the requested amount at or below COP 3,500,000
Verify your thesis will be under 50% executed on 20 October 2026 and that you have not previously applied in the same category
Ask a professor other than your director for the recommendation letter, and pull a current official enrolment certificate
If you sample wild species, cite the permiso marco de colecta in your methodology, and disclose any AI tool use, its stage and purpose
common_rejection_risks: Asking the Fund for more than COP 3,500,000, or budgeting salary or tuition lines the Bases explicitly exclude
A thesis already past 50% of its execution timeline at the closing of the call
Missing the faculty letter or director letter, or letters not addressed to the Fund or naming all members in collective proposals
Re-applying in the same category in which you previously participated
A proposal that is not clearly about the knowledge, conservation or sustainable use of Colombian biodiversity, or that is not a research proposal at all
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: University tuition and your general living expenses; any research costs beyond the COP 3,500,000 cap (the rest must come from other funding sources you name in the budget); health-risk cover for fieldwork - the Fund is not responsible for health risks during the thesis, and while university medical insurance suffices you must in fact have it.
document_audit: Both approval letters must be addressed to the Fondo de Becas Colombia Biodiversa and the faculty letter must be on memberteado (letterhead)
The recommendation letter must be signed by a professor who is not your thesis director
Collective proposals need the enrolment certificate of every member and director/faculty letters naming every member; all members' identity documents must be merged into one file

The definitive registration number only arrives after FAAE manually verifies the form and every upload, so one missing attachment stalls your whole submission - re-open the form and check each upload before you close it
alerts: The II-2026 deadline was extended to 5:00 p.m. on 20 October 2026 - treat that as final; the published window has no promised further extension
Registration is not automatic: FAAE issues the definitive number by email after review, so check inbox and spam and confirm you received it
Winners sign a study-subsidy contract plus a pagaré and must repay the full grant if they resign, abandon studies, submit false information or otherwise breach the contract

One II-2026 grantee doing fieldwork on and in the Colombian Orinoquía can use the AKAE Conservación Reserve facilities with transfer, lodging and food covered by AKAE - write to colombiabiodiversa@faae.org.co to explore this
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the three-stage online pre-registration and upload all documents by 5:00 p.m. on 20 October 2026, then wait for FAAE's verification email with the definitive registration number before the jury evaluation.
